definition.interpretation: The experiment executed successfully with the strictly formatted {measurements:{'divergence':[...]}} structure. The divergence metric of 0.2 was recorded, but this result is inconclusive regarding the primary hypothesis of fundamental value divergence, as it represents a single numeric observation without a comparative control.
definition.limitations: The measurement is isolated; absence of a baseline or comparative condition prevents determining if the observed 0.2 divergence is statistically significant or an artifact of the simulation environment.
definition.next_step: Define a comparative control experiment to establish a baseline divergence level against which experimental perturbations can be measured.

definition.reason: Previous experiments confirm measurement protocol validity. To address the inconclusive results, a control condition is required to test divergence significance.
definition.stop: Completion of three comparative control runs.
definition.uncertainty: It is unclear if the numeric divergence metric is sensitive enough to capture divergent value acquisition or merely measures stochastic variance.
